description: This file contains style definitions related to text formatting, alignment, transformation, weights, colors, and responsive utilities for a web project using Bootstrap. It includes class definitions for text alignment, casing, font weight, colors, and utility mixins for responsive design and hiding text.

methods.name: text-truncate
methods.description: Mixin that applies CSS styles to truncate overflowing text with ellipsis.

methods.name: text-hide
methods.description: Mixin to visually hide text while keeping it accessible for screen readers.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-up
methods.description: Mixin to apply styles from a certain breakpoint upward for responsive design.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Function to generate infix strings for breakpoints.

methods.name: text-emphasis-variant
methods.description: Mixin to apply emphasis color variants to text elements.
